comments: Configuration for the consolidated VAMS v2.5 to v2.6 migration (OpenSearch reindex + asset-history backfill + workflow-executions storage overhaul). The single script v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py runs all steps; select with --steps.
_comment_prefix: Required: SSM resource-name base prefix from CDK core stack output 'ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput' (format: /{configName}-{baseStackName}/resourceNames). When set, the reindexer function name is resolved automatically from SSM Parameter Store.
_comment_function: Optional override: explicit reindexer Lambda function name (CDK stack output 'ReindexerFunctionNameOutput'). Only needed when the SSM prefix above is not filled in, or to override the SSM-resolved value.
_comment_history: Asset history backfill (phase 2). Table names resolve automatically from the SSM prefix; the explicit overrides below are only needed when the prefix is not set.
_comment_aux_preview: auxPreviewRelocation step: moves aux-bucket preview objects from {assetLocationKey}{relativeFileKey}/preview/... to {databaseId}/{assetLocationKey}{relativeFileKey}/preview/... (the asset location key may include a custom base prefix, so matching is on that base, not a bare assetId). The aux bucket + asset table names resolve automatically from the SSM prefix; the explicit override below is only needed when the prefix is not set (asset_storage_table_name above is reused for the asset location-key -> databaseId lookup).
_comment_operation: What to reindex: 'assets', 'files', or 'both' (default: both). Reindex step only.
_comment_clear: v3 indexes are empty after the v2.6 CDK deploy, so leave clear_indexes=false on first run. Set it to true only when re-running against an already-populated v3 index. Reindex step only.
_comment_source: Legacy execution table (PK databaseId:assetId, SK executionId) - read source
_comment_main_v2: V2 main execution table (PK workflowExecutionId, SK workflowDatabaseId:workflowId)
_comment_pexec: Pipeline executions table (PK pipelineExecutionId, SK workflowExecutionId)
_comment_pin_files: Pipeline execution input files table (PK pipelineExecutionId)
_comment_workflows: Workflow definition table (read source for specifiedPipelines; also the V1 read source for the pipelineWorkflowDefinitions step)
_comment_defs_step: ===== STEP: pipelineWorkflowDefinitions (V1 -> V2 pipeline/workflow DEFINITION migration) =====
_comment_defs: Migrates user-database (non-GLOBAL) pipeline + workflow DEFINITIONS from the V1 tables into the V2 tables. GLOBAL built-ins are skipped (re-created by the CDK vamsSchema importer at deploy time). All five table names resolve automatically from resource_names_ssm_param_prefix; the explicit overrides below are only needed when the prefix is not set. (workflow_storage_table_name above is reused as the V1 workflow read source.)
_comment_safety: ===== Shared safety options (apply to both steps) =====
_comment_aws: AWS configuration (optional - override with CLI flags)
_comment_instructions: How to use this configuration file
_instructions: === SETUP ===
1. Get the SSM resource-name base prefix from the CDK core stack outputs:
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name your-vams-stack \
--query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput`].OutputValue' \
--output text
2. Set 'resource_names_ssm_param_prefix' in this file to that value, and set
'aws_region' (and 'aws_profile' if needed). The reindexer Lambda function name
is then resolved automatically from SSM Parameter Store.
Alternative: set 'reindexer_function_name' explicitly (CDK stack output
'ReindexerFunctionNameOutput') to skip or override the SSM lookup.
3. workflowExecutions step: set the six *_storage_table_name* fields to your stack's DynamoDB table names
(from the CloudFormation stack outputs or the DynamoDB console).
=== EXECUTION (single consolidated script; --steps selects which step(s) to run, default all) ===
4. Dry run first (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED), all steps:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --dry-run
5. Production migration, all steps:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json
6. Run only one step if needed:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --steps reindex
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --steps assetHistory
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --steps workflowExecutions
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --steps auxPreviewRelocation
7. (Reindex re-run only) Clear the v3 indexes first if a previous run partially populated them:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --steps reindex --clear-indexes
=== WHAT THIS DOES ===
Reindex step: invokes the deployed reindexer Lambda (handlers.indexing.crReindexer) to repopulate the new
vams-assets-v3 and vams-files-v3 indexes from DynamoDB and S3 (the new geo_MD_location field is derived
by the indexer from each entity's metadata).
workflowExecutions step: reshapes legacy workflow execution rows into the V2 workflow-keyed data model
(main + workflow inputs + per-pipeline execution stubs + first-pipeline input files). Idempotent
(deterministic GUIDs); the legacy V1 table is never modified. If a workflow/pipeline no longer exists,
the pipeline-execution stub uses pipelineId='DELETED' so the file linkage is preserved.
=== OPENSEARCH 3.5 UPGRADE NOTE (PROVISIONED ONLY) ===
If you are running provisioned OpenSearch (config.app.openSearch.useProvisioned.enabled=true) and the
v2.6 CDK deploy of the OpenSearch domain version upgrade (2.7 -> 3.5) fails on an existing domain,
deploy first with config.app.openSearch.useProvisioned.enabled=false to delete the domain, then redeploy
with it re-enabled. The new domain is created on 3.5 and this migration repopulates it from source data.
Serverless deployments are unaffected by the engine upgrade.
=== SAFETY ===
- dry_run: reindex step does a no-op count pass; assetHistory + workflowExecutions steps compute records without writing
- limit: caps the number of items processed per step (testing only)
- clear_indexes: reindex step only; defaults to false; v3 starts empty so the first run never needs it
=== ASSET HISTORY BACKFILL STEP ===
- After the reindex, the script backfills the new AssetHistory table from existing asset records:
a 'create' record from each asset's v0 version record (when present), plus 'archive'/'unarchive'
records inferred from the asset's archivedAt/archivedBy and unarchivedAt/unarchivedBy fields.
- Backfilled records are flagged migratedRecord=true and use a deterministic record ID, so re-runs
overwrite rather than duplicate.
- Table names are resolved from the SSM prefix; set the explicit *_table_name overrides only when needed.
- Set skip_asset_history_backfill=true (or --steps without assetHistory) to skip it.
- dry_run and limit apply to this step as well.
=== AUXILIARY PREVIEW RELOCATION STEP ===
- Moves existing auxiliary-bucket preview/viewer data (e.g. Potree octree files) from the old
{assetId}/{relativeFileKey}/preview/... layout to the per-file {databaseId}/{assetId}/{relativeFileKey}/preview/... layout.
- The aux bucket name and asset table name resolve from the SSM prefix (asset_auxiliary_bucket_name /
asset_storage_table_name overrides only needed when the prefix is not set).
- Each asset's databaseId is looked up from the asset storage table and inserted in front of the assetId path.
- Reserved working prefixes (pipeline/pipelines/temp-upload/temp-uploads) are ignored; the step is idempotent.
- dry_run logs each planned move without copying; limit caps objects scanned.
